issue.title: Render eighth-level fluid tops and partial step faces
issue.body:
## Background

After #2517 fluid tops render flat at whole-z steps, after #2520 every
`FluidCell` carries an exact eight-unit surface, and after #2525 eight
approved level masks are tracked. This slice joins them: a fluid top is drawn
at its exact eighth height with the matching level mask, and side geometry
terminates exactly at the neighbouring fluid or terrain height. This is the
first slice where a partial quantity becomes visible.

Verified on `master` `e89e61bb1` (2026-09-07), before the prerequisites:

- Fluid top quads place their vertices from the integer surface:
  `relativeZ = fluidZ - zSlice`, `heightOffset = relativeZ * tileSideHeight`
  (`src/World/Render/TileQuads.hs:295-301` for freshwater, the same shape
  for `oceanTileToQuad` and `lavaTileToQuad`). Ocean and lava select
  `wtIsoFaceMap`; freshwater selects a slope map by id, which #2517 fixes at
  the flat map.
- The per-chunk fluid pass culls by integer surface
  (`fcSurface fc > zSlice ∨ fcSurface fc < zSlice - effectiveDepth`,
  `src/World/Render/Quads.hs:340`), skips Ocean/Lake quads under ice
  (`:353-374`), and draws ice at the integer `icSurface` (`:317-320`).
- `waterSideQuad` draws one full-tile quad per whole z of gap using
  `wtSideFaceMapLeft`/`Right`, with vertex y from the integer z
  (`src/World/Render/SideDecoQuads.hs:128-200`); `waterSideFaceQuads`
  excludes Ocean (`fcType fc ≢ Ocean`, `:47`) and draws nothing for an
  unloaded neighbour chunk. #2517 makes it own the one-z gap.
- Face maps reach the renderer through Lua: `scripts/startup_loader.lua`
  preloads the PNGs (`:298-315`), `scripts/world_view.lua:97-112` loads
  them, `scripts/world_manager.lua:18-37` registers them with
  `world.setTexture(worldId, "<name>", handle)`, `parseTextureType`
  (`src/Engine/Scripting/Lua/Material.hs`) maps the name to a
  `WorldTextureType`, and `WorldTextures`
  (`src/World/Render/Textures/Types.hs:28-46`) holds one handle per map.
  `getTileFaceMapTexture` (`src/World/Render/Textures.hs:21-30`) selects by
  slope id.
- #2520 introduces the render-only float height and the `topFillLevel`
  helper (1..8, exact multiple = 8) that this slice consumes; #2525 tracks
  masks whose top diamond is unchanged and whose sides cover `2 * level`
  rows.

## Requirements

1. The eight approved level masks are preloaded, loaded, registered by name,
   parsed into `WorldTextureType`, and held on `WorldTextures`, following the
   existing face-map route. `tools/check_texture_paths.py` sees every
   reference.
2. Every fluid top (River, Lake, Lava, Ocean) selects its face map from the
   exact top fill level 1..8, never from float rounding, and places its
   vertices at the exact surface height using float only at that point. A
   top is flat regardless of neighbouring height.
3. For each camera-visible edge, the renderer compares the owning cell's
   exact plane with the neighbour's exact fluid plane, or its terrain
   surface when dry, and emits the necessary full-z side segments plus one
   partial segment so the side terminates exactly at the owning top and the
   neighbour's top. Mixed neighbouring levels within one z, a full-z stack
   with a partial cap, and multi-z drops compose with neither gaps nor
   overlap. Equal or higher neighbours produce no side; enclosed equal-height
   fluid has none; an unloaded neighbour chunk still draws nothing.
4. Ocean takes the same geometry path with no ocean-only branch: the
   `fcType ≢ Ocean` exclusion in `waterSideFaceQuads` is removed. Generated
   Ocean sits at level 8 and therefore renders flat with no sides beside
   equal neighbours; a partial edited or runtime Ocean cell uses the matching
   mask and sides.
5. Z-slice and effective-depth visibility, sort keys, ice cover (skip and
   ice placement at the exact plane's integer ceiling), and in-chunk,
   ordinary-seam, and cylindrical U-seam neighbour lookups all give the same
   result for the same geometry, for all four camera facings.
6. Terrain slope rendering, the terrain-bed rule, zoom-map water
   classification, and the existing fluid tint values are unchanged.
7. Pure headless specs cover: mask selection for each level 1..8 and for an
   exact multiple; vertex y for each partial level; full-plus-partial side
   decomposition for a same-z partial neighbour, a partial cap over a full-z
   stack, and a multi-z drop; in-chunk versus cross-chunk and U-seam parity;
   unloaded-neighbour conservatism; z-slice visibility at a partial plane;
   sort ordering; all four facings; and Ocean taking the same path as Lake.
8. The owner reviews an offscreen scene showing levels 1..8 beside dry
   terrain, adjacent mixed levels, a whole-z stack with a partial cap, river,
   lake, lava, and partial ocean variants, at all four facings and at day and
   night lighting, and approves it before merge.
9. Comments and docs describing whole-z fluid placement or the two-z side
   rule are updated repo-wide.

## Acceptance

```bash
cabal build all
cabal build synarchy-test-headless
cabal test synarchy-test-headless --test-options='--match "World.Render.SideFace"'
cabal test synarchy-test-headless --test-options='--match "<new fluid-level render group>"'
cabal test synarchy-test-headless --test-options='--match "World.Slope.slopeBit"'
python3 tools/check_texture_paths.py
```

Expected: warning-clean build; the side-face group and the new level group
(named by the PR) are green with every case in requirement 7; the terrain
slope group is unchanged and green; every texture reference resolves.

```bash
grep -rn "≢ Ocean" src/World/Render/SideDecoQuads.hs
```

Expected: no matches.

Offscreen QA: following `tools/offscreen_probe.py`'s boot pattern, script
the requirement-8 scene (place partial cells with the exact-surface edit
path #2520 provides), capture base and branch screenshots at all four
facings, and attach them to the PR for owner signoff. Screenshots are
evidence for a human decision, not a byte comparison.

## Out of scope

- Generated-river eighth-level surface progression (DFL-5); generated
  rivers still render whole-z planes at level 8.
- Exact-unit diagnostics, dump, or cursor fields (DFL-6).
- Animated interpolation, waves, foam, refraction, or per-frame smoothing.
- Eighth-level depth on zoom-map pixels.
- New masks, mask changes, or material recolours (#2525 owns the assets).
- Changing fluid tint values or the tinting policy.

## Related

- Epic #2514 (DFL-4). Phase 3, critical path. Blocked by #2517 (DFL-1),
  #2520 (DFL-2), and #2525 (DFL-3). DFL-5 and DFL-6 are blocked by this
  issue.
- Design notes: `docs/discrete_fluid_levels_design.md` §Flat step
  presentation, §Level masks and assets; D-1, D-2, D-3, D-4, D-7, D-10,
  D-12.

## Automated cross-agent issue review

Reviewed against `master@5b677136fdac` by GPT-6-Astra (`gpt-6-astra` at `high`).

**Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED**

Corrections and spec additions below amend the implementation spec. Supporting context is non-normative. Open decisions remain unresolved and must not be guessed.

### Corrections
- **GPT-6-Astra:** Requirement 5 conflates fluid height with ice height. World.Fluid.Ice.computeChunkIce creates drape ice at max(terrain, fluid) + 1 and basin ice up to 20 z above that base; World.Render.Quads renders icSurface. Substituting the fluid ceiling would collapse that existing geometry (src/World/Fluid/Ice.hs:73–92; src/World/Render/Quads.hs:311–331).
- **GPT-6-Astra:** Limit requirement 9 to descriptions of current behavior. Preserve historical evidence, migration explanations, and descriptions of earlier delivery phases; their whole-z references remain accurate (docs/discrete_fluid_levels_design.md, §§Persistence and migration and DFL-1; CLAUDE.md, findings-status ownership).

### Spec additions / clarifications
- **GPT-6-Astra:** Verify the combined silhouette of the selected top mask and separate side geometry. The approved masks already contain side pixels, so those pixels must participate in requirement 3's no-overlap and exact-endpoint contract. Include unequal left/right neighbour heights and an equal-height enclosed cell; counting side quads alone is insufficient (docs/discrete_fluid_levels_design.md, §Level masks and assets; src/Engine/Graphics/Vulkan/ShaderCode.hs:249–312).
- **GPT-6-Astra:** Include both initial world binding and late structural-texture rebinding in requirement 1, with verification that each level resolves to its intended handle. The integration route also includes World.Texture.Types and handleWorldSetTextureCommand, whose cache invalidation must be retained (scripts/world_manager.lua:11; scripts/world_view.lua:142; src/World/Thread/Command/Texture.hs).
- **GPT-6-Astra:** Extend requirement 7 with negative absolute surfaces, zero as an exact whole-z wet plane, and partial surfaces on both sides of the effective-depth boundary. Pin slice ownership to the prerequisite's documented ceiling convention and test actual production visibility decisions (docs/discrete_fluid_levels_design.md, §Exact surface vocabulary; src/World/Render/Quads.hs:340).
- **GPT-6-Astra:** Keep required documentation, reproducible capture evidence, and the recorded owner verdict within this implementation PR's completion criteria before final review and merge, following the supplied AGENTS.md publication-lane agreement.

### Supporting context
- **GPT-6-Astra:** Snapshot 5b677136fdacb75a604da796e066c50710c128b7 confirms integer top placement, whole-z side stacks, and the Ocean side exclusion; the requested fractional rendering is not already implemented (src/World/Render/TileQuads.hs; src/World/Render/SideDecoQuads.hs).
- **GPT-6-Astra:** The declared prerequisite split matches the tracked design: DFL-2 supplies exact state, DFL-3 supplies approved masks, and DFL-4 owns rendering integration. Their absence from this snapshot is not a blocker (docs/discrete_fluid_levels_design.md, §Delivery plan).

### Open decisions
- **GPT-6-Astra:** Should requirement 5 preserve icSurface and the existing drape/basin elevations, using the fluid ceiling only when deriving their base, or intentionally relocate covered ice to the fluid ceiling? These produce materially different geometry, and the latter exceeds a straightforward fluid-render conversion (src/World/Fluid/Ice.hs:73–92; issue requirement 5).

### Recommended disposition
- **GPT-6-Astra:** Clarify requirement 5 before readiness approval. Recommend preserving the existing ice elevations and adding covered partial Lake/Ocean plus dry drape/basin regression cases; if relocation is intentional, explicitly scope that behavior and its acceptance evidence (src/World/Fluid/Ice.hs; src/World/Render/Quads.hs).

### Reviewer summaries
- **GPT-6-Astra — CHANGES REQUESTED:** The rendering scope is viable with the declared prerequisites assumed landed. Requirement 5 needs an owner decision: placing ice at the fluid ceiling would replace the existing independently elevated ice surface.
